intro: Stolen Enchanting Supplies is an errand undertaken near the Tower of Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest. An apprentice named Blixie Fitzwink lost a shipment of magical reagents during a gnoll ambush, and adventurers must retrieve the stolen goods from camps around Stone Cairn Lake. Recovering the materials spares the apprentice severe chore duty and keeps Master Theocritus's arcane studies supplied.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was sent by Master Theocritus to pick up some enchanting supplies from the trading post, but on the way back I was ambushed by a pack of gnolls!
I dropped the package and escaped, but if I return without it, I'll be cleaning up after the polymorph experiments for weeks as punishment! Do you think you could find the supplies for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, that's a relief! It looks like it's all here. Thank you!
